title: FarikPriceTable
description: The model price table Farik ships and the user may override in .farik/prices.json: what one million tokens cost, per model id, in US dollars. See docs/SPEC.md section 5.5.

version.description: The table's format version; 1 for this shape.

source_url.description: The provider's published price page the numbers were copied from.

retrieved_at.description: The day the numbers were copied, ISO 8601.

prices.description: Prices keyed by the provider's model id, exactly as the runtime reports it in usage.

cache_write_usd_per_mtok.description: Prompt cache writes with the five-minute duration, the one the agent engine uses.
